cands.name: Ron Bolton

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 61 since November 2022. Retired from the Northport Police Department, where he was a captain; he retired in 2011. Also listed as managing principal of The Warwick Group LLC and as a business executive.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Ron Bolton was born or raised, or when he moved to Alabama. The pages we read list no bills he sponsored and no stated positions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, campaign money, policing, guns, abortion or schools. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. We found no documented endorsements, controversies, foreign ties, or public statements on data centers or development. The dates and details of his role at The Warwick Group LLC are not given.

qual.background: Alabama House member since November 2022 (re-elected in 2026); previously a captain with the Northport Police Department until retiring in 2011; managing principal of The Warwick Group LLC.
qual.why: He has prior legislative service plus management experience as a managing principal of a business, which fits the high band. His time as chair of the Tuscaloosa County Legislation Committee and his board seats are not counted. No law, policy or budget career is documented, so the score stays at the low end of the high band.
